entries.description: An educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center for women of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds on 52 acres of farmland. Includes a visitor's house called Star House. Welcomes new members/residents, women with dependent children, and children.
entries.raw_text: WHO FARM INC 37010 SE Snuffin Rd, Estacada, OR 97023 (503)630-6728. Who farm is an educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center for womyn of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds. We have 52 acres of beautiful farmland, fields, hills, evergreens, a visitor's house in the magical woods called Star House. Our land is located approx 30 miles SE of Portland with a city bus (NO 31) running within 5 miles of the farm. Visitors may stay max 2 weeks. We charge $4 per night's stay in Star House. Womyn with dependent children are welcome. Bring your own food. We have very rainy weather and lots of mud so sisters bring rain gear and goulashes! There's no electricity in Star House. We welcome: new members/residents. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 52 acres, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land, inactive group with hopes to revive (trying to get back on our feet).
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on 'new members/residents' and 'women living on the land'. Accepted groups: 'womyn of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds' implies Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women (before 1986 rule), and 'dependent children' implies Girl children and Boy children. Focuses: educational and job skill center implies Workshops/education; farmland implies Farming/self-sufficiency. Land location inferred from contact address.

entries.description: A non-profit educational community organization teaching rural skills to women and their children on 60 acres. Offers camping spaces and cabins for trade and rent. Welcomes new members/residents, girl and boy children, and nonlesbian women.
entries.raw_text: PENTHESILEIA, INC Box 97 Star Route 2, Seal Rock, OR 97376 (503)563-3643. Penthesileia, Inc is a non-profit educational community organization teaching rural skills to women and their children. A matrix between rural and urban. We have camping spaces and cabins for trade and rent. Group rentals available. No violence. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, leashed dogs, work exchanges. We have/are: 60 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on 'educational community organization' and 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted groups explicitly state 'nonlesbian women', 'girl and boy children'; 'women' without modifier before 1986 includes Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women. entries.description: A community on land with food and flower gardens, orchards, woods, and pasture. Raises chickens, sheep and working ponies. Welcomes girl children, boy babies, and nonlesbian women. Residents work various jobs in town.
entries.raw_text: RAINBOW'S END Rt 3 Box 3645, Roseburg, OR 97470 (503)673-7649. Our land embraces food and flower gardens, orchards, woods and pasture. We raise chickens, sheep and working ponies. We're paying for our home by working various jobs in town. Visitor policy: visits must be prearranged by mail or phone. Land use fee: $2-$4 per day, food: $4 per day. Sometimes, for specific projects, work exchange may be arranged. No dogs!!! We welcome: girl children, boy babies, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 5 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land, women working in town.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on 'women living and working on the land' and '5 lesbians'. Accepted groups: explicitly lists 'nonlesbian women' and children ('girl children, boy babies'); 'lesbians' implies Lesbian women. Focuses: gardens, orchards, raising animals indicates Farming/self-sufficiency. Land location inferred from contact address.

entries.description: A feminist retreat on 23 acres of forested land in Southern Oregon. Plans summer and winter sessions with workshops, skillsharing, discussion groups, recreation and home-cooked meals. Features a main house, several women-built cabins, and secluded spots for camping. Welcomes girl children.
entries.raw_text: WOMANSH'ARE Box 681, Grants Pass, OR 97526 (503)862-2807. A feminist retreat on forested land in Southern OR. We plan summer and winter sessions for 10-30 women - workshops, skillsharing, discussion groups, recreation and home-cooked meals. We have a main house and several women-built cabins for sleeping and many secluded spots for camping. The main house has electricity, hot water and a shower. Visitors are asked to contribute $3/day for food and $1-3/day to our land support fund. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 5-10 lesbians, 23 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity (outdoor toilet), camping space, woods, farmland, women living/working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it explicitly calls itself 'A feminist retreat'. Accepted groups: 'women' implies Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women (before 1986 rule), 'girl children' explicitly included. Focuses: 'workshops, skillsharing' indicates Workshops/education. Land location: 'Southern OR' stated.

entries.description: A residential community with a community center on the ocean. Offers members limited-stay visits and two cottages available for 1-year lease. Welcomes new members/residents, nonlesbian women (as non-resident members only), and girl children.

Membership is $10-$20/mo. We currently have two cottages available for 1 year lease. We welcome: new members/residents (we rent cottages on a monthly basis only), girl children, nonlesbian women (as non-resident members only). We have/are: about 15 lesbians, small community on ocean, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.

entries.description: Key West's only guest house for and by women. Features individually decorated rooms with baths, AC, TV, pool, large hot tub, and sundecks. Welcomes new guests, lesbians, nonlesbian women, and boy children over 9 years.
